oracle.scope: Offline validity, structural stratification and reference labels only. No inference labels supplied.

overlap_audit.scope: Game identities and full-position equivalence excluded; recurring local motifs are expected transfer, not independent evidence. Opening families partitioned globally. Human identities and engine-opening reuse may remain correlated.

leakage_audit.policy: No new training; complete-board translation/color/file equivalence excluded. Atomic local relations intentionally recur. Opening families disjoint across development/calibration/test. Games within a family are clustered, not IID human games.

limitations: Seeded random legal games are synthetic, not human or engine play.
Adversarial edits are paired and share source ancestry.
Full-board equivalence exclusion does not establish independence of all local features.
